items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: Henry Bussey seemed to be the one to produce that.

ctx.x: What style would he play? Would he play just a straight four?

Yeah. Yeah. No, no, no. Those early bands, I don't remember them playing shuffle rhythm. The only one, the first band I remember playing shuffle rhythm was this trumpet player. Oh man. What is his name? Any of you gentlemen remember? Here in town? No, no, it was a nationally known orchestra. Henry Bussey? Henry Bussey. That's the first shuffle rhythm I can recall. Henry Bussey seemed to be the one to produce that. And these guys down here would play four or two of them? Oh, they'd just play a beat, man. Four…
When would they play two beats? If ever?
